main.limits: Every scheduled attempt counts, including failures, timeouts and pending work. Accepted means the common-quality verdict, which needs an independent blind cleanup review. Tokens sum both sessions and stay unknown when either session's usage is missing; Claude totals include subagents. A Claude session that times out reports no totals; observed input tokens (uncached input, cache reads and writes, subagents included) come from its log and survive timeouts, but the log holds no final output counts. Re-orientation time is polled to the first src/ or tests/ change in session 2, and its Claude tokens are main-loop input only; Codex reports usage per session only, so its tokens before that edit are unknown. A renamed test counts as deleted. Helper calls count commands naming zagrosi_skills.py. Probe failures are evidence, not certainty, and four repetitions per arm and case are observations, not statistically established effects.
